resources.string: The other players follow and enter the game on their own phones, with no account and no Internet: phones talk directly to each other, encrypted.
Outdoors: this phone creates a small Wi-Fi network without Internet, which the others join by scanning the QR code (Android 13 or later).
All phones are on the same Wi-Fi (some public or “guest” networks isolate phones: try the hotspot then).
Have this QR code scanned in Molkky Board › Join
No network: turn on Wi-Fi, or choose the hotspot.
The hotspot could not start (Android 13 or later, “Nearby devices” permission). Try “Same Wi-Fi”.
Sharing could not start. The game continues on this phone.
This QR code is not a Molkky Board invitation.
Could not join the game network: move closer, or ask for “Same Wi-Fi”.
This is not the organiser\'s phone: connection refused.
Scan the QR code shown on the organiser\'s phone.
Only your nickname and throws are sent, directly to the organiser; never a photo.
Accept the “Connect to network” window if Android shows it. Stay close to the organiser.
This QR code was already used or has expired: scan the one shown now.
Different Molkky Board versions: update the app.
This phone is no longer part of the game.
